definitions.explanation: Items that come with or can be added to a main product, such as cables, adapters, cases, or other supplementary components.

examples.japanese: {付属品|ふぞくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{充電|じゅうでん}→充電：04427_juuden⟧⟦ケーブル→ケーブル：04432_keeburu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{付属品|ふぞくひん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: This product comes with a charging cable as an accessory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{付属品|ふぞくひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦{欠|か}けていた→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Since I bought it secondhand, some of the accessories were missing.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used in product descriptions, manuals, and shopping contexts. Distinct from ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧ (parts/components), which refers to internal components rather than supplementary items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {付属品|ふぞくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (to check the accessories)
- {付属品|ふぞくひん}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧ (list of included accessories)
- {付属品|ふぞくひん}なし (without accessories)
- {付属品|ふぞくひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揃|そろ}っている→揃う：01953_sorou⟧ (all accessories are included)
